name: dispatch
description: Cross-agent dispatch guidance for model selection, reasoning effort, task handoff, and result verification

interface.shortDescription: Choose and brief subagents, then verify their work.
interface.longDescription: A focused cross-runtime skill for selecting a suitable worker model and reasoning effort, handing off bounded work to subagents or external model CLIs, diagnosing failed runs, and verifying returned artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Use $dispatch to plan and delegate this work to subagents.
Use $dispatch to get an independent review from another model.
